verdict.rationale: Scheduled or background autonomous automations are a fair capability for an AI model/API platform, but nothing in the pack documents one. The Batch API covers one-off asynchronous bulk processing, not a recurring or autonomous automation. Tool calling and multi-agent research are request-scoped agentic features, so they are adjacent and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
